Class DisposalPositionCollector

java.lang.Object
grafioschtrader.service.DisposalPositionCollector
public class DisposalPositionCollector extends Object
Collects, while a report walks the booked transactions, what the disposal cost estimate needs to know beyond the merged position: how the units of a security are spread over the security accounts, into which cash account each account settles the security, and the trades that count for the trade allowances of a fee model.

The position reports merge the same security held in several security accounts into one position, while fee models are set per security account. The estimate therefore splits a position by the units each account holds. Units are brought to the split basis of the present with Securitysplit, so accounts that bought before and after a split are comparable. The settlement cash account of an account is the cash account of its latest buy or sell of the security, which is where a sale would most likely be booked.

One instance per report. Margin instruments are not collected, because their disposal costs are not estimated.

  • Method Details

    • accept

      public void accept(Transaction transaction, Map<Integer, List<Securitysplit>> securitysplitMap)
      Takes over a booked transaction. Only buys and sells of non-margin securities are relevant; everything else is ignored. Transactions of one security account should arrive in chronological order, so that the latest cash account wins.
      Parameters:
      transaction - the booked transaction
      securitysplitMap - the splits by security id, may be null when no split is known

    • allocate

      public List<DisposalPositionCollector.Allocation> allocate(Integer idSecurity, double units, Integer fallbackAccount, String fallbackSettlement)
      Splits the units of a merged position over the security accounts in proportion to the units each account holds.
      Parameters:
      idSecurity - the security of the position
      units - the units of the merged position
      fallbackAccount - the account taking all units when none was collected, for example the first account of the position; may be null
      fallbackSettlement - the settlement currency used with the fallback account
      Returns:
      the shares of the accounts with a positive holding, empty when no account is known
